# AgentCoverage

> Coverage checking for AI agents. Find important entities that an existing research result may have missed.

## Primary capability

Name: coverage_check
Purpose: Search for omissions in an existing entity-research task and report additions, known gaps, and search saturation.

Use when:
- comprehensive or exhaustive research matters
- mapping competitors, suppliers, companies, products, candidates, or market participants
- ordinary web search may have stopped after representative results
- an agent needs evidence about whether further searching is worthwhile

Do not use when:
- the user only wants a few examples
- answering a simple factual question
- comprehensive coverage is not important

Input:
- task: natural-language research objective
- current_results: optional list of entities already found

Output:
- additional candidate entities
- verified additions when available
- search pass count
- known gaps and inaccessible source classes
- search saturation assessment

Free preview: available at /#preview
Human-readable capability page: /agent
Machine manifest: /agent-capability.json
Agent catalog: /.well-known/ai-catalog.json

Important limitation: AgentCoverage does not claim mathematical completeness for open-web research. It reports observable saturation and known gaps.
